title: responsible-ai domain — catalog record contract
description: Cross-cutting Responsible-AI principle catalog with a CROSSWALK: each principle maps to the enterprise non-financial-risk (NFR) domains and the assessing lenses that evidence it. Anchored on Australia's AI Ethics Principles and aligned to NIST AI RMF and the AWS Responsible-AI dimensions. A specific system's per-principle pass/fail for a run is a CONCLUSION — NEVER cataloged (it is a run output).

rai-principle.description: A Responsible-AI principle + its crosswalk to the NFR domains and assessing lenses that evidence it. The crosswalk is what lets the eco roll existing lens findings up into a principle-level coverage view without re-assessing.

nfr_domains.description: the enterprise NFR domains whose findings evidence this principle

evidencing_lenses.description: the eco lens/agent ids whose findings evidence this principle

what_good_looks_like.description: the control/evidence that would satisfy this principle
